title: VDS NEON BAZAAR (City Pop × Vaporwave × Future Funk) [115]
style: Japanese city pop meets vaporwave and future funk, 115 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Japanese + Mandarin + te reo Maori, slap bass funk lines, glittering FM electric piano, chopped and pitched-up disco vocal samples, tape-warble pads, brass stabs, gated funk drums, neon shimmer lead synth, female chops pitched +7 and male chops at -3, neon-Tokyo-rooftop sunset mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club crossover 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(FM electric piano, tape warble, distant city hum)
(VDS... ne... on... ba... zaar...)
(yo... ru... yo... ru...)
(ye... wan... ye... wan...)

[Build]
(slap bass enters, brass stabs swell, funk hats double up)
VDS! NE — ON! BA — ZAAR!
YO — RU! YO — RU!
YE — WAN! YE — WAN!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(snare roll, FM piano climb)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor funk kick, slap bass groove, neon lead)
NE — ON!
BA — ZAAR!
CI — TY!
SIG — NAL!
(chop stack +7) hai-hai-shi-shi / āe-āe-hai-hai
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(FM piano solo phrase, brass accents, chops trade)
(doko?) (nǎr?) (kei hea?)
(koko!) (zhèr!) (konei!)
(ikou!) (zǒu ba!) (haere!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE NEON —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to FM piano + tape warble, no drums)
(whispered) vds... neon... bazaar...
(soft) yoru... yoru...
(soft) yewan... yewan...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds, slap bass returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time funk, full neon stack peak, brass doubled)
VDS — NE — ON — BA — ZAAR! (hai hai hai!)
CI — TY! (zǒu ba! ikou!)
SIG — NAL! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(funk fades, FM piano resolves, tape warble holds)
(vds... neon... bazaar...)
(yoru... yewan...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(neon synth pad fades to silence)
